title: What Are AI Agents?
content: AI agents are systems that perceive their environment and take actions to achieve goals. They combine language models with tool use, memory, and planning to complete complex multi-step tasks autonomously.

text: AI agents combine language models with tool use, memory, and planning to complete complex multi-step tasks autonomously.
This is the key definition to remember — tool use + memory + planning = agent.

title: Agent Frameworks Comparison
content: Major frameworks include LangChain, AutoGen, and CrewAI. Each provides different abstractions for orchestrating multi-agent systems. LangChain focuses on composability, AutoGen on multi-agent conversation, and CrewAI on role-based agent crews.

text: Voice note: I think CrewAI's role-based model maps well to how YC companies should think about deploying agents — give each agent a job title and clear responsibilities.
